column1: # The official Umm al-Qura month starts of 1447-1450 AH (year, month, first day as a Gregorian date, days in the month). Taken from the KACST conversion service (ummulqura.org.sa) as AsimNet/ummulqura-calendar (MIT, (c) 2026 AsimNet) scraped it, all 2196 months of 1318-1500 AH; ummulqura.org.sa itself is not reachable from the cloud container that wrote this. Cross-checked in tests/hijri_crosscheck_test.py against Chromium's ICU (the page), the JDK's Hijrah-umalqura and, when ICU4J_JAR is set, ICU4J (the launcher uses android.icu). Do not edit by hand.
